name: RowNumberNode
label: Row Number
description: Adds a column with a sequential row number. If partition columns are given, the numbering restarts at 1 for each partition.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to add row numbers to.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. Row numbering restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the row number column. Defaults to 'RowNumber'.
